First public release of **JD Highlighter**, a pair of borderless themes for JDownloader 2 with
one accent colour you pick yourself: **JD Highlighter Dark** on IBM Carbon `#161616` and
**JD Highlighter Light** on `#f4f4f4`. Both have rounded cards, clean line icons and large fills
that stay neutral, so text reads well at any hue. They run on the desktop app and in the
JDownloader-for-Unraid container.

## Added

- **Colours for JD's own content areas.** `theme/cfg/laf/FlatDarkLaf.json` and
  `FlatLightLaf.json` set the Carbon `colorfor*` palette for the download list, link grabber,
  settings table and scrollbars. The lists sit on a card (`#242424` in Dark, white in Light),
  the selection stays a readable grey, and the hover row takes the accent.
- **Control theme.** The two `.properties` templates in `theme/flatlaf/` make fields, combos
  and buttons borderless, give everything one 8px corner radius and carry the accent to
  toggles, tabs, menus, focus and progress.
- **Theme agent.** `jd-highlighter-agent.jar` handles what JD hard-codes: it swaps the chrome
  icons for [Tabler](https://tabler.io/icons) line icons, lays the lists and settings sections
  onto rounded cards, rounds the buttons, turns the menu bar into pills, makes menus and dialogs
  borderless and replaces the coloured progress globes with a plain accent ring. Hoster lists
  show each site's own colour logo instead of JD's grey placeholder, and the donate tab's
  holiday icons get a line icon too. The agent is built for Java 8, so it loads on every Java
  that JDownloader ships with, and it is the same agent the container uses.
- **A free accent, picked in JD.** Settings › User Interface has an Accent colour row with a
  colour picker and an Appearance row for Dark or Light. JD offers a restart after a change.
  Any colour works, default `#ffee00`, and text on the accent switches between dark and light
  automatically.
- **Installers** for Windows (`install/install.bat`, `install/install.ps1`) and Linux/macOS
  (`install/install.sh`). They install Dark, or Light with `-Variant light` (Windows) or a
  third argument `light` (Linux/macOS), pick the matching FlatLaf look and feel, switch off
  JD's ads, render the accent and load the agent through JDownloader's `.vmoptions`. Running
  them again is safe, and `install/uninstall.ps1` / `install/uninstall.sh` remove everything
  again.
- **Container support.** In the JDownloader-for-Unraid container JD Highlighter Dark is the
  default and `JD_THEME=jd-highlighter-light` starts in Light. The accent and the variant
  picked in JD are kept in `/config` and survive image updates.

## How to use

Download `jd-highlighter-v1.0.0.zip`, unzip it and run the installer for your OS, then restart
JDownloader. If JD has not used a FlatLaf design before, it downloads one on that start and
restarts once more on its own. Pick the accent and Dark or Light under Settings › User
Interface. The README covers the installer options and uninstalling.

## Credits

The two-path technique comes from the dark theme in the JDownloader-for-Unraid container. Icons
by [Tabler](https://tabler.io/icons) (MIT); the agent bundles [ASM](https://asm.ow2.io/)
(BSD-3-Clause). Sibling to jd-plain-dark.
